import: Degree divisibility for an actual closed polynomial embedding of A1 in the plane
title: An approach to plane algebroid branches
location: Theorem 6.9, Abhyankar-Moh Embedding Line Theorem, second formulation
used_implication: For a closed polynomial embedding t maps to (P(t),Q(t)) over a characteristic-zero field, if both coordinate polynomials are nonconstant, one coordinate degree divides the other.
original_attribution: S. S. Abhyankar and T. T. Moh, Embeddings of the line in the plane, J. Reine Angew. Math. 276 (1975), 148-166
same_retained_source_previously_used_for: The local normalization statements in critical-normalization-import.json; Theorem 6.9 is an additional explicit input here.
not_imported: Degree divisibility for a merely rational curve or a nonembedded parameterization
An affine-line conclusion from a normalization alone
A generic-rational-fibre theorem inferred from one special fibre
A plane Keller surjectivity or singleton-zero properness theorem
assurance: The exact degree statement and its proof were inspected in the primary v1 research manuscript. The already retained v1 PDF bytes are reused and pinned. Exact controls do not reprove the imported theorem.
